label: PF Backlog 566
title: Unscoped triage: re-home 'Unscoped' children into real epics (grooming cadence + aging advisory)
body:
## Goal
Keep `Unscoped` small: an ongoing curation loop re-homes its children into real epics.

## Behaviour
- Periodic/at-grooming: list `Unscoped` children (+ suggested epic) -> attach to an existing epic, or create a
  new epic when a cluster forms; empty it out.
- A growing `Unscoped` is the signal that a real epic is missing.

## Implementation (later)
- Mark the `Unscoped` epic `holding: true` (done in BI-PF-1250) so it is excluded from real-epic stats.
- Aging advisory (children older than N days) + a grooming-cadence hook (grooming-guidelines.json periodic).

## Acceptance
- Given `Unscoped` children, when the triage runs, then each is moved to a real epic (or a new epic created).

## Deferred - recorded now.
